title.zh-TW: 載入速度與系統優化
title.en: Faster Loads & System Polish

zh-TW: 大幅縮減網頁初次載入體積，開啟與切換頁面更輕快
補齊行程頁自動化測試並清理底層警告，提升系統穩定度
en: Trimmed initial web bundle size by over 40% for faster page loads
Added itinerary page automated tests and resolved internal framework warnings

title.zh-TW: 行程操作列、足跡清單與設定體驗優化
title.en: Itinerary Actions, Logbook & Settings Polish

zh-TW: 行程頁整合新增方案與新增項目按鈕，切換預覽方案改為行內設為採用
重整足跡期間旅程清單，手機完整顯示長標題與國名並對齊電腦版欄位
設定頁旅遊偏好改為選完自動儲存，同步精簡手機版字級、分頁與按鈕比例
en: Unified itinerary Add Plan and Add Item actions and moved plan activation inline
Redesigned Logbook period trips with full mobile titles and an aligned desktop ledger
Enabled instant auto-save for Settings preferences and tightened mobile tabs, typography, and buttons

title.zh-TW: 後端冷啟動喚醒畫面與趣味提示
title.en: Server Wake Screen & Travel Tips

zh-TW: 後端冷啟動期間自動鎖定操作並顯示航線進度，快速回應時不干擾
喚醒等待時隨機輪播中英文功能小撇步與作者冷笑話，支援手動切換
等待期間仍可透過右上角頭像切換語言、查閱更新日誌或登出
en: Locked actions behind an aviation wake overlay during slow cold starts while skipping fast responses
Added rotating bilingual travel tips and dev jokes with manual skip while waiting
Kept the account menu available to switch languages, read release notes, or sign out

title.zh-TW: 卡片底部降噪、導覽與表單文案精簡
title.en: Cleaner Card Footers & Form Copy

zh-TW: 將行程卡底部的車次、座位與確認碼改為純文字顯示，僅保留附件與記帳標籤
移除桌面版旅程分頁籤的裝飾圖示，讓版面焦點回歸文字
精簡各處表單提示與選填標註，去除多餘的括號說明
en: Rendered transit, seat, and booking codes as plain footer text while keeping interactive chips
Removed decorative icons from desktop trip tabs for a calmer header
Simplified form labels and placeholders by removing redundant parenthetical hints

title.zh-TW: ChatGPT 助理串接與行程章節調整
title.en: ChatGPT Integration & Day Header Polish

zh-TW: 支援串接 ChatGPT 專屬助理，可直接讀寫行程與記帳
重整設定頁 AI 串接指引，分流桌面工具與 ChatGPT 設定步驟
行程天數標題補上星期顯示，未填當日主題時自動收合
en: Added ChatGPT Custom GPT support for reading and updating trips and expenses
Reorganized AI setup in Settings into separate MCP and ChatGPT guides
Added weekdays to day headers and collapsed empty day themes

title.zh-TW: 手機底部導覽、花費分頁與行程預設優化
title.en: Mobile Bottom Nav & Expenses Tabs

zh-TW: 手機版旅程內改用底部導覽切換頁面，向下捲動時自動收合頂部標題
手機版花費頁新增快速記帳與明細分頁，並改善明細卡片排版
進行中旅程自動定位至今日天數，並調整新增景點與卡片編號顯示
en: Added in-trip mobile bottom navigation and auto-hid the header on scroll
Split mobile Expenses into Quick Add and Ledger tabs with cleaner category badges
Opened active trips directly on today's day and streamlined item cards

title.zh-TW: 行程欄位驗證、AI 連線整併與金額格式
title.en: Detail Validation, Remote AI & Number Formatting

zh-TW: 補齊航班、住宿時間與轉乘耗時等明細欄位的格式驗證
統一 AI 助理連線至遠端端點，並補齊旅程、排序、分享與花費編修工具
花費金額全面套用千分位與幣別小數格式
en: Added format validation for flight, hotel check-in/out, and transit details
Unified AI integration on the remote endpoint with full trip and expense editing
Formatted expense totals and rows with thousand separators and currency decimals

title.zh-TW: 離線唯讀防呆、地圖下拉關閉與鍵盤操作
title.en: Offline Guards, Map Swipe & Keyboard Support

zh-TW: 離線或檢視快取時自動停用編輯與記帳按鈕，保留導航與檢視功能
手機地圖抽屜支援下滑關閉，無座標天數自動隱藏地圖按鈕
補齊國家選擇器與行程卡片的鍵盤操作，並改善新旅程預設國別
en: Disabled editing controls while offline while keeping navigation and viewing active
Added swipe-to-close on the mobile map sheet and hid empty-day map buttons
Added keyboard navigation for country pickers and cards with smarter country defaults

title.zh-TW: 足跡頁面改版、方案分頁籤與表單統整
title.en: Travel Logbook, Plan Tabs & Form Styling

zh-TW: 將儀表板改版為「足跡」，整合飛行與陸路總里程及歷年統計
將每日多方案切換改為底線分頁籤，精簡時段候選按鈕樣式
統一全站輸入框高度、底色與主要按鈕外觀
en: Redesigned Dashboard into Travel Logbook with combined air and ground distance stats
Switched Plan A/B controls to underline tabs and simplified slot-choice buttons
Standardized input heights, surfaces, and primary button styles across pages

title.zh-TW: 全站表單下拉選單、日期選擇器與自動發布機制更新
title.en: Unified Form Dropdowns, Calendar Date Pickers & Release Retries

zh-TW: 將旅程管理、行程表單、花費記帳與個人設定的所有下拉選單統一改為一致的懸浮選單元件
旅程開始與結束日期及花費日期欄位支援直接輸入 YYYY-MM-DD 與點擊開啟月曆點選
為 GitHub Release 自動發布流程加入失敗重試與手動重跑支援
en: Unified all remaining dropdown menus across Trips, Itinerary, Expenses, Quick Expense, and Profile
Upgraded trip and expense date fields to support both manual YYYY-MM-DD entry and interactive calendar selection
Added automatic retries and manual workflow dispatch support to GitHub Release publishing

title.zh-TW: 行程時間輸入升級、下拉選單與按鈕修正
title.en: Time Input Picker, Dropdown Styling & Onboarding Button Fix

zh-TW: 行程項目表單的開始與結束時間支援直接鍵盤輸入 24 小時制時間，也可點擊開啟時間選項清單點選
統一管理後台與各頁面表單下拉選單的外觀樣式與焦點框
移除新手引導「前往設定」按鈕多餘的連結底線
en: Upgraded itinerary item start and end time inputs to support both manual 24-hour typing and preset slot selection
Unified dropdown menu borders, chevrons, and focus states across Admin Console and app forms
Removed the unintended link underline on the empty-state Settings button

title.zh-TW: 邀請連結自動開通、新手引導與轉乘卡片修正
title.en: Direct Invite Links, Empty-State Guide & Transit Card Fix

zh-TW: 管理後台的邀請碼新增「複製連結」，朋友點擊連結登入後會自動帶入並兌換邀請碼，免手動輸入
新帳號首次進入空的旅程總覽時，顯示三步驟快速上手引導與建立旅程按鈕
移除在地轉乘卡片重複的排序箭頭，避免壓縮標題空間
修正正式環境因嚴格 CSP 阻擋內嵌樣式切換腳本導致全站樣式未套用的問題
en: Added a Copy Link button for invite codes in Admin Console so friends auto-redeem after sign-in
Added a 3-step onboarding card on the empty Trips overview for new accounts
Removed duplicate inline reorder arrows from local transit pills so titles no longer get compressed
Fixed production stylesheet loading blocked by strict CSP inline-script enforcement

title.zh-TW: 親友邀請制、邀請碼兌換與管理後台
title.en: Invite-Only Access, Invite Codes & Admin Console

zh-TW: 改為親友邀請制：未經開通的帳號登入後會導向邀請碼兌換頁，輸入邀請碼即可啟用功能
新增角色分級（OWNER / ADMIN / FRIEND / USER）與停權機制，停權後同步阻擋網頁與 API Token
新增管理後台，支援帳號權限管理、撤銷金鑰與批次產生邀請碼
en: Added invite-only onboarding: unapproved accounts are routed to an invite-code redemption page before accessing trips
Added 4-tier account roles (OWNER / ADMIN / FRIEND / USER) and account suspension blocking both web sessions and API tokens
Added an Admin Console in the account menu for user role management, token revocation, account deletion, and batch invite codes

title.zh-TW: 站內更新紀錄與版本同步
title.en: In-App Changelog & Version Sync

zh-TW: 點擊頭像選單底部的版本號即可查看各版本更新紀錄
有新版本時會在頭像與版本號旁顯示未讀小點，點開後清除
站內更新紀錄與 GitHub CHANGELOG.md 改由同一份來源自動產生
en: Click the version badge in the account menu to view release history
Show an unread dot on the avatar and version badge for new versions, cleared on open
Generate the in-app changelog and GitHub CHANGELOG.md from one source file

title.zh-TW: AI 助手工具統一與自動帶入匯率
title.en: Unified AI Tools & Auto-FX Expenses

zh-TW: AI 助手記帳若未指定匯率，會自動帶入即時匯率換算
統一本機與遠端 AI 助手的工具參數與行為
en: Auto-fill live exchange rates when logging expenses without an explicit rate
Aligned tool parameters and behavior across local and remote AI assistants

title.zh-TW: 存取防護與手機地圖資源最佳化
title.en: Access Guards & Mobile Map Optimization

zh-TW: 加入 API 呼叫頻率限制、外部連結檢查與登入存取控管
手機版切換清單與地圖時只保留單一地圖實例，降低記憶體佔用
en: Added rate limiting, external link checks, and login access controls
Mounted a single map instance on mobile to reduce memory usage when switching views

title.zh-TW: 跨日住宿路線更新與計算效率改善
title.en: Multi-Day Stay Routing & FX Performance

zh-TW: 調整跨日續住飯店或景點後，自動更新後續天數的路線與距離
改善多幣別花費換算速度與資料寫入穩定度
en: Recalculate downstream day routes automatically when multi-night stays or stops change
Improved multi-currency expense conversion speed and write reliability

title.zh-TW: 行程頁、行前總覽與登入頁版面調整
title.en: Itinerary, Trip Brief & Login Layout Update

zh-TW: 調整每日行程章節、行前總覽（Trip Brief）與儀表板卡片排版
儀表板數據加入數字遞增動畫，登入頁改為地圖背景樣式
en: Updated layout for daily itinerary chapters, Trip Brief, and dashboard cards
Added count-up numbers on the dashboard and a map-styled login screen

title.zh-TW: 自訂 Logo、時間排序與編輯流程補齊
title.en: Custom Logo, Time Sorting & Complete Editing

zh-TW: 換上 Tripilot 自訂 Logo、瀏覽器圖示與手機主畫面圖示
新增依時間自動排序、拖曳調整順序、卡片與地圖連動，以及機場搜尋
補齊旅程與花費的編輯／刪除確認視窗，並統一幣別選項
en: Added custom Tripilot logo, favicon, and mobile home-screen icons
Added chronological insert, drag-and-drop reordering, map sync, and airport search
Completed trip and expense edit/delete confirmations and unified currency options

title.zh-TW: 離線快取、曲線路線與公開分享頁調整
title.en: Offline Cache, Curved Routes & Share View

zh-TW: 支援加入手機主畫面（PWA）與離線快取，無網路時可查閱已載入行程
地圖預設顯示曲線路線並可切換行車路線，涵蓋機場接送與續住飯店
精簡公開分享頁上方導覽與手機天數切換版面
en: Added PWA install and offline caching to view loaded trips without signal
Defaulted to curved route lines with a driving-route toggle covering airports and stays
Compacted the public share header and mobile day-switching layout

title.zh-TW: 中文地標地圖與 Plan A/B 備案管理
title.en: CJK Map Labels & Plan A/B Management

zh-TW: 更換為支援中文地標顯示的地圖樣式
補強每日 Plan A / Plan B 備案建立、複製、更名與切換，並改善手機地圖載入速度
en: Switched map tiles to display localized CJK place labels
Expanded Plan A/B creation, cloning, renaming, and switching, and improved mobile map load time

title.zh-TW: AI 助手連線設定與手機地圖預覽卡
title.en: AI Connect Settings & Mobile Map Preview

zh-TW: 設定頁新增 AI 助手連線說明與個人 API Token 管理
手機版地圖點擊地標後，於底部顯示地點與時間預覽卡
en: Added AI Connect setup instructions and Personal API Token management in Settings
Added a bottom preview card on mobile when tapping map pins

title.zh-TW: 帳號登入與單一時段多選切換
title.en: Account Sign-In & Slot Choice Switching

zh-TW: 支援 Google 與 Email 帳號登入，可跨裝置同步行程
固定行程頁頂部天數列、加入手機版滑動地圖，以及同一時段多候選項目即時切換
en: Added Google and Email/Password sign-in for cross-device sync
Pinned the itinerary day header, added a mobile map drawer, and added instant slot-choice switching

title.zh-TW: 旅遊統計儀表板與手機版版面修正
title.en: Travel Stats Dashboard & Mobile Layout Fixes

zh-TW: 改版旅遊儀表板：新增全部／國際／國內篩選、花費分類統計與國家排行
修正手機版頁面水平溢出問題與右上角地圖開關
en: Updated the travel dashboard with scope filters, spend breakdown, and country rankings
Fixed horizontal overflow on mobile pages and wired the top-right map toggle

title.zh-TW: 初期版本：行程規劃、行前總覽與即時匯率記帳
title.en: Initial Beta: Itinerary, Trip Brief & Live FX

zh-TW: 提供行程規劃、卡片快速記帳與即時匯率自動帶入
新增行前總覽（Trip Brief）分頁，彙整住宿日期、交通訂位與雲端附件
en: Added core itinerary planning, quick card expense entry, and live FX rate lookup
Added Trip Brief to list hotel spans, transit bookings, and cloud attachments
